payload.reason: The evidence suggests that the quality of medical articles on Wikipedia is influenced by the use of domain-specific vocabulary, indicating that a poorly written article may lack such jargon.

claims.text: Bad medical Wikipedia articles are likely to contain less domain-specific jargon, as quality is associated with the use of specific vocabulary.
The effectiveness of evaluating medical articles improves when domain-specific features are considered, implying that poor articles may not utilize these features effectively.
